turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on a, an and the?
turns.tutor:
Hello! First, one example from me.
I have ___ pen. The word "pen" starts with "p". "P" is not a vowel sound. So I write "a". I have a pen.
In one line: use "an" when the next word starts with a vowel sound, "a" when not.
Right: She eats an apple. Wrong: She eats a apple.
Now you try. Write a or an:
She has ___ orange in her bag. (answer with only the missing word)
